synopsis: CSIRO contributes expert observations on visibility and driver response: a researcher described dust hiding a light vehicle in South Africa and cited an average driver reaction time of about one second [f3230, f3311]. The one-second estimate is expert opinion, not a field-measured distribution for heavy-machine operators [f3311]. The brake-timing chapter likewise attributes about one second to CSIRO (2007), within a collection of assumptions ranging from 0.5 to 2.5 seconds and patent margins of 1–3 seconds; this variation cautions against treating one second as a universal assumption [f6228]. CSIRO was not assessed as a tools provider, so its recorded status is “not found,” rather than evidence that it does not offer relevant tools [f8835, f16090, f16120].
